falsification_closures: Exact frozen cell render bytes, transport instruction fusion, on-disk packet/message identities, exact stdin bytes, and requested model/reasoning-effort argv are independently rebound before each subject launch.
Canonical spawn-request and attempt schemas, deterministic nonce derivation, no-retry/no-relaunch/no-best-of flags, and causal-input storage identities are validated before dispatch.
Each admitted row uses one fresh shell-free codex exec --ephemeral process with no retry, relaunch, replacement, or best-of path.

CLI JSONL requires one UUID-bearing thread lifecycle, exactly one turn, completed agent_message before turn completion, no post-terminal events, and exact output-last-message reconciliation modulo one terminal LF.

Observed activity is durably captured for successful, malformed, nonzero, timeout, and start-failure paths; opaque generic tools are conservatively classified and terminal totals are recounted from per-row captures.
Runner-request reads, CLI execution, runner EOF, post-SIGKILL drains, and residual process-group probes are bounded; detected residual groups invalidate the transport.

Codex runs with an explicit read-only sandbox; output roots are exclusive and nonoverlapping; protected Matrix005 and Matrix006 states are pinned and checked before and after every subject and at terminal postflight.
Exact Codex binary bytes, five local config-layer presence/bytes, accepted HOME/CODEX_HOME, and selected nonsecret environment selectors are checked before and after each subject and at postflight.
Launch-attempt and process-start records are written at their respective boundaries; terminal counts derive from durable captures so later assertion failures cannot erase consumed launches.
Post-launch component, config, environment, protected-state, inventory, count, and activity failures are converted to controller-invalid terminal evidence rather than qualification.
The canary schedule is exactly three rows, one per declared route, all bound to frozen cell_order[0]; the matrix schedule path is statically 291 rows but is not granted authority by this review.
